profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Dotdash
profile.summary: I am an Atlanta-based former non-profit employee and law student turned frontend developer, interested in building community.

positions.title: Law Clerk
positions.description:
1. Wrote persuasive briefs on behalf of clients to the United States Citizens and Immigration Services (USCIS) to adjust immigration status
2. Conducted immigration law research on behalf of clients to best serve their needs and understand the applicable law
3. Maintained positive client relationships by being available, prepared, and respectful of their needs

positions.title: Line Therapist
positions.description:
1. Provided ABA therapy to children on or at risk of being on the Autism spectrum in clinic and at home
2. Assisted guardians develop skills to better acclimate their children to the world around them
3. Developed therapy plans and coordinated with other care providers to find what works best for children

volunteerExperiences.description: I provided community assistances to Athens senior citizens eligible for Senior SNAP benefits. I dealt with sensitive topics such as violence in the home, substance use, and money management. The most was in organizing events for senior socialization since senior citizens face high degrees of depression and social isolation.
